exports.name: scan_string
exports.signature: pub fn scan_string(input: &[u8], opening_quote: u32) -> Result<StringScan>
exports.behavior: Discovers absolute raw/content spans and the first escape, handles consecutive-backslash parity, rejects opening and unescaped-control errors, reports missing delimiters, and validates bounded raw UTF-8 after discovery. Escape spelling and surrogate validation are deferred.

exports.name: first_special
exports.behavior: Finds the earliest quote, backslash, or control byte below 0x20 in arbitrary bytes without ABI-length narrowing or UTF-8 validation.

coverage: Empty discovery, all 256 byte classifications, earliest-special selection, and arbitrary invalid UTF-8 discovery inputs.
Every discovery position in lengths 1 through 130, plus subslice alignment starts 0 through 65 and lengths 0 through 128 with an excluded quote sentinel.
Empty strings, absolute token spans, content slices, next offsets, trailing bytes, and earliest absolute escape position.
Opening positions at EOF, beyond EOF, and u32::MAX; nonquote openings including controls and invalid UTF-8.
Unclosed strings, dangling backslashes, escaped terminal quotes, and consecutive-backslash runs through 130 bytes.
All raw unescaped controls, escaped-control discovery, invalid escape spellings, incomplete Unicode escape spellings, and surrogate spellings deferred to decoding.
Valid ASCII, DEL, two/three/four-byte UTF-8, combining marks, BOM, and U+10FFFF without normalization.
Isolated continuations, overlong encodings, invalid continuations, UTF-8 surrogates, above-range code points, invalid leading bytes, and truncated sequences with absolute leading-byte errors.
Closure and raw-control error precedence over UTF-8 errors; escaped bytes included in raw UTF-8 validation.
Token-local UTF-8 validation, exact input-subslice bounds, input immutability, repeatability, and independent sequential scans.
Private scanner length guard at zero, one, u32::MAX, and above u32::MAX when the host can represent it, without oversized allocations.
